spec.title: Enable encryption at rest
spec.description: Turn on the datastore's built-in at-rest encryption with keys in a managed KMS/HSM and rotation enabled.

implementation.postgresql: pgcrypto for column-level encryption, or LUKS/dm-crypt at the volume level.
implementation.mongodb: Enterprise Advanced: WiredTiger Encryption at Rest with a KMIP provider.

verification.manual: Check that the datastore is marked encrypted in the provider console.
